sections.title: Wearing something
sections.content: The verb for wearing is *visel*. It takes the accusative: the thing worn gets *-t*, and the verb has the endings you know for an indefinite object. Ask *Mit visel Anna?* and answer *Anna kék kabátot visel.* Without a number the noun stays singular, even for a pair: *fekete cipőt visel*.

items.english: I am wearing a white shirt.
Károly wears jeans and a T-shirt.

sections.content: *Farmer* (jeans) is one word with a singular object: *farmert*. Other objects: *kabátot, inget, szoknyát, ruhát, sapkát, cipőt, pólót, nadrágot*.
